name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Uplift: The American Dream
changes.summary: We celebrate the United States ahead of its 250th anniversary with stories about American heroes and pastimes. The founder of e.l.f. Cosmetics shares how he made a massive life change to become a Catholic priest.

changes.title: Maps show wildfire smoke forecast, air quality alerts due to pollution from Canadian, Minnesota fires
changes.summary: Heavy smoke from several large wildfires blazing in Canada and Minnesota is engulfing large swaths of the Midwest and Northeast U.S. this week.

changes.title: Dozens of Marineland's whales coming to U.S. through rescue plan
changes.summary: Dozens of beluga whales are set to be relocated from the shuttered Canadian theme park to aquariums across the United States through an international emergency rescue effort, officials said.

changes.title: Sen. Mark Warner slams Trump's primetime speech: "Incredible lies"
changes.summary: Sen. Mark Warner joined CBS News with his reaction to President Trump's primetime address on U.S. election security.

changes.title: Trump administration to declassify documents relating to China and U.S. elections
changes.summary: President Donald Trump addressed the nation from the White House, announcing that the administration will declassify documents related to the 2020 election and alleged influence by China.

changes.title: How paper ballots make digital manipulation of results unlikely
changes.summary: NBC News’ Jane Timm analyzes President Trump’s claims about digital manipulation of ballot results in the U.S., as Trump said that the White House will declassify documents related to the 2020 election and alleged influence by China during his speech to the nation.

changes.title: An analysis of President Trump's address
changes.summary: President Trump gave a primetime address Thursday night in which he spoke about the integrity of U.S. elections — a topic he has spread disinformation about for much of his political career.

changes.title: Diesel Prices Hit $5 a Gallon Again, Up 33% Since Start of Iran War
changes.summary: U.S. diesel prices first surpassed $5 a gallon in March. Renewed fighting in the Persian Gulf and reduced refinery capacity is once again pushing up prices.

changes.title: Maps Show Where Wildfire Smoke Will Darken Skies on Thursday
changes.summary: Air quality in several cities reached hazardous levels on Thursday morning as smoke was expected to move across North America.

changes.title: Wildfire Smoke Turns Skies Orange Across the U.S., and Democrats Make a Big Shift on Israel
changes.summary: Plus, why Gen Z is turning to trade schools.
